features.name: circular spawn platform
features.notes: Large platform at the center of the hub
features.quote: A large circular spawn platform at the center where players spawn.

features.name: blue green deck pattern
features.notes: Colorful checkered or spiral pattern across platform
features.quote: The platform should have a colorful checkered or spiral pattern feel. Bright blue and green tones.

features.name: glowing center spawn pad
features.notes: Set on top of platform in the center; yellow or white glow
features.quote: A glowing center pad on top of the spawn platform where players appear. Glowing yellow or white.

features.name: left green white kiosk
features.notes: Left side of spawn pad; boxy stall with counter and small roof
features.quote: A simple boxy shop/kiosk stall on the left side of the spawn pad, with a counter and small roof. Green and white colors.

features.name: right blue white kiosk
features.notes: Right side of spawn pad; boxy stall with counter and small roof
features.quote: A simple boxy shop/kiosk stall on the right side of the spawn pad, with a counter and small roof. Blue and white colors.

features.name: purple arched portal
features.notes: Standing on one side of platform; visibly glowing
features.quote: An arched gateway portal on one side of the platform. Purple and glowing.

features.name: floating cyan magenta crystals
features.notes: Crystal and gem shapes hovering above spawn area
features.quote: Floating crystal/gem shapes hovering above the area. Bright cyan or magenta.

features.name: scattered gold coin cylinders
features.notes: Decorative cylinders scattered around platform deck
features.quote: Decorative coin/decoration cylinders scattered around the platform. Gold/yellow.

features.name: low pale platform fence
features.notes: Ringing main platform; white or light gray fence or wall border
features.quote: A low fence or wall border around the main platform for visual containment. White or light gray.

excluded.name: shared persistent world
excluded.why: multiplayer world structure not visually verifiable

excluded.name: exposed attributes
excluded.why: editor configuration not visible in render
